tasks.name: Add HITL queue counts helper
tasks.objective: Create ONE new file, modify none: Northstar_backend/agent_kernel/hitl_counts.py. It must define hitl_counts(root) using only the standard library: scan (Path(root)/'state'/'hitl').glob('hitl_*.json'), load each JSON object, count status values pending/approved/denied, ignore unreadable files, and return {'pending': int, 'approved': int, 'denied': int, 'total': int}. If the directory is missing, return all zeros. Do not create a test file; the acceptance command will exercise the function.
acceptance_commands: import sys,tempfile,json; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0,'Northstar_backend'); from agent_kernel.hitl_counts import hitl_counts; d=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); h=d/'state'/'hitl'; h.mkdir(parents=True); (h/'hitl_20260101T000000_deadbeef.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'pending'})); (h/'hitl_20260101T000001_deadbeef.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'approved'})); r=hitl_counts(d); assert r=={'pending':1,'approved':1,'denied':0,'total':2}, r
